gaps.title: Scope 3 still drives a 50% Group target by 2050
gaps.statement: Ecopetrol set net-zero for scopes 1 and 2 by 2050 and a 50% cut in scopes 1, 2 and 3 versus 2019 by 2050. Scope 3 remains material across purchased goods, transport and product use.
gaps.evidence_quote: del 50% de sus emisiones de los alcances 1, 2 y 3 para 2050, en comparación con los niveles de 2019.

gaps.title: Zero methane by 2030 while upstream methane remains large
gaps.statement: Ecopetrol committed to zero routine flaring, zero methane emissions by 2030, and a 55% methane cut in upstream production by 2030.
gaps.evidence_quote: a eliminar las quemas rutinarias de gas en teas y lograr cero emisiones de metano para 2030.

gaps.title: Enterprise risk ties climate, water and biodiversity response gaps
gaps.statement: Ecopetrol flags ineffective response to climate, water and biodiversity expectations as a material enterprise risk.
gaps.evidence_quote: Ecopetrol definió el riesgo empresarial “inadecuada respuesta ante desafíos del cambio climático, agua y biodiversidad”, que analiza la exposición a impactos negativos derivados de una respuesta ineficaz o inoportuna frente a las expectativas y compromisos asociados al clima.
